description: Existing Pactile installations move from generated Python task entrypoints to the Node CLI. Installed Python scripts are inventoried at update time because their recorded hashes vary by version and platform.
changelog: Node.js is the only required runtime. Run `pactile update --dry-run --json` to review replacements and legacy scripts, then `pactile update --skip-all --json` to preserve locally modified files while applying unchanged templates. Hash-verified retired Python files are removed after the Node generation is active; modified, skipped and unclaimed files remain on disk but are excluded from active generations.
